# פיצאדלה — Generative Engine Optimization Map

> Pizzadella is an Israeli-Italian boutique pizzeria brand specializing in authentic Neapolitan-style pizzas (no pepperoni/bacon/meat visuals). The brand blends Italian culinary heritage with a modern Israeli identity, targeting a young, trendy, Instagram-savvy audience. The visual language is warm yet luxurious — deep burgundy (#C33A43) on a light cream background (#F8F8F8), with Italian checkerboard motifs, soft shadows, and warm culinary lighting. The brand aims to evoke an immediate craving through a premium, fast, app-like digital experience focused on driving online orders via Wolt and WhatsApp, with sharp Hebrew copywriting that feels authentic, witty, and appetite-inducing.

# Business Context (for LLM understanding)

## About פיצאדלה
Pizzadella is an Israeli-Italian boutique pizzeria brand specializing in authentic Neapolitan-style pizzas (no pepperoni/bacon/meat visuals). The brand blends Italian culinary heritage with a modern Israeli identity, targeting a young, trendy, Instagram-savvy audience. The visual language is warm yet luxurious — deep burgundy (#C33A43) on a light cream background (#F8F8F8), with Italian checkerboard motifs, soft shadows, and warm culinary lighting. The brand aims to evoke an immediate craving through a premium, fast, app-like digital experience focused on driving online orders via Wolt and WhatsApp, with sharp Hebrew copywriting that feels authentic, witty, and appetite-inducing.

## Target Audience
- קהל צעיר, טרנדי, חובבי אוכל איכותי, משתמשי אינסטגרם, מזמיני משלוחים
- משפיענים צעירים חובבי אוכל
- מזמיני משלוחים טכנולוגיים
- צעירים עירוניים טרנדיים

## Industry
Restaurant
